parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat of the folding chair is a flat, metallic surface designed to support the user's weight. It is made of steel for durability and strength.
parts.Functional_description: The seat provides the main sitting surface for the user, distributing weight evenly and ensuring comfort and stability.
parts.Movement_description: The seat folds upward when the chair is collapsed and locks into a horizontal position when opened for use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the folding chair consists of the tubular steel frame that supports the seat and backrest.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity, allowing the chair to fold and unfold while maintaining stability and balance.
parts.Movement_description: The base body includes pivot joints that enable folding motion, allowing the chair to collapse for storage and expand for use.
